prior_year_events.impact_description: An unusually active North Atlantic hurricane season with a record number of storms making US landfall led to a frequency of weather losses that affected prior year development.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 839.0m. Using the gross claims development table, there was a net adverse prior-year development of GBP 28.0m (approximately 3.34% of opening reserves) driven largely by adverse re-estimation on 2019 underwriting (partially offset by a small release on 2018). Management attributes the movement principally to Covid-19 event cancellation losses and natural catastrophe activity (notably active Atlantic hurricane seasons), and states that they strengthened loss assumptions on certain lines following deterioration in 2019.
raw_causal_phrases: Despite the improvement in market conditions and underwriting actions taken internally the year of account was materially impacted by both Covid-19 losses (in our event cancellation business) and natural catastrophe losses.
We also took the decision to strengthen our initial expected loss ratio on certain lines of business following the deterioration we experienced in 2019 on prior years.
an unusually active North Atlantic Hurricane season with a record number of storms making US landfall

The 2021 calendar year was yet another year of severe weather losses, the year starting with the very unusual Storm Uri and continued with a very active Atlantic storm season, this year was rated the second largest natural catastrophe year for insured losses by Munich Re.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 28.0m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (note 25) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2018 and 2019 (excluding 2020 and 2021). The report mentions a historical reinsurance to close of 2017 (Riverstone) which may distort very old-year comparatives, but the disclosed triangle for 2018-2021 was used. Exact textual disclosure of a gross prior-year movement amount was not provided; the amount is therefore computed from the triangle. The 'Aviation' line was presented in the note with parentheses; the amount above follows the printed figure (negative in the table).
